arguments.command:
set -eu
BASE=/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp
ENV="$BASE/ollama-runtime.env"
EXPECTED=4514bcd3f855895524c7ebd8f55913b2d6d2ba32270bde295d687a852fc95e49
STAMP="$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
CP="$BASE/checkpoints/ollama-bounded-residency-$STAMP"
mkdir -p "$CP"
chmod 700 "$CP"
actual="$(sha256sum "$ENV" | awk '{print $1}')"
[ "$actual" = "$EXPECTED" ] || { echo "CAS_ABORT env_sha=$actual"; rmdir "$CP" 2>/dev/null || true; exit 20; }
cp -p "$ENV" "$CP/ollama-runtime.env.before"
python3 - "$ENV" <<'PY'
import sys, pathlib, os
p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
s=p.read_text()
old="export OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=-1"
new="export OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=10m"
if s.count(old)!=1:
    raise SystemExit("CAS_ABORT expected KEEP_ALIVE line exactly once")
tmp=pathlib.Path(str(p)+".tmp-bounded-residency")
tmp.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
os.chmod(tmp,0o600)
os.replace(tmp,p)
PY
echo "ENV_AFTER_SHA=$(sha256sum "$ENV" | awk '{print $1}')"
grep '^export OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=' "$ENV"
pid="$(cat "$BASE/ollama-runtime.pid" 2>/dev/null | tr -dc '0-9' || true)"
if [ -z "$pid" ] || [ ! -r "/proc/$pid/cmdline" ] || ! tr '\0' ' ' < "/proc/$pid/cmdline" | grep -F "$BASE/miniconda/bin/ollama serve" >/dev/null; then
  pid_display="$pid"; [ -n "$pid_display" ] || pid_display=none
  echo "RESTART_ABORT owned_pid_not_verified pid=$pid_display"
  cp -p "$CP/ollama-runtime.env.before" "$ENV"
  exit 21
fi
echo "OLD_PID=$pid"
kill -TERM "$pid"
i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 20 ] && [ -r "/proc/$pid/cmdline" ]; do sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done
if [ -r "/proc/$pid/cmdline" ]; then
  echo "RESTART_ABORT old_pid_still_alive"
  cp -p "$CP/ollama-runtime.env.before" "$ENV"
  exit 22
fi
"$BASE/bin/ollama-keepalive" ensure
newpid="$(cat "$BASE/ollama-runtime.pid" 2>/dev/null | tr -dc '0-9' || true)"
echo "NEW_PID=$newpid"
curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version
echo
echo '--- EFFECTIVE_ENV ---'
tr '\0' '\n' < "/proc/$newpid/environ" | grep '^OLLAMA_' | sort
echo '--- API_PS_AFTER_RESTART ---'
curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/ps
echo
echo "ROLLBACK=$CP/ollama-runtime.env.before"
